segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: And then here on this one, tell me everything you see going on in this picture. Well, I see the mother is not paying attention and her water is running over her sink.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: The boy has climbed up on a ladder to steal some cookies and he's falling over.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: The girl is laughing. The grass is growing outside. Nobody seems to care. They're just going on with their daily activities.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: Anything else you see? No right or wrong answers, but is there anything else you see going on in the picture? No, not really.
